units.source: Attachments

A __TRILIUM_PH_0__note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in Trilium can __TRILIUM_PH_2__own__TRILIUM_PH_3__ one or more attachments, which can be either images or files. These attachments can be displayed or linked within the note that owns them.

This can be especially useful to include dependencies for your __TRILIUM_PH_0__scripts__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The __TRILIUM_PH_2__Weight Tracker__TRILIUM_PH_3__ shows how to use __TRILIUM_PH_4__chartjs__TRILIUM_PH_5__ which is attached to the script note.

Each note exclusively owns its attachments, meaning attachments cannot be shared or linked from one note to another. If an attachment link is copied to a different note, the attachment itself is duplicated, and the copies are managed independently thereafter.

Attachments, especially image files, are the recommended method for embedding visuals in notes. It is important to link image attachments within the text of the owning note; otherwise, they will be automatically deleted after a configurable timeout period if not referenced.
Types of attachments__TRILIUM_PH_0__
There are two different types of attachment:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__User content__TRILIUM_PH_1__, representing files or images that are uploaded and part of the content of the note.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__System attachments__TRILIUM_PH_1__ which are used internally by Trilium and can be of multiple types, including:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to store information about views such as the column information for the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Kanban Board__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Icons and cover images for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
Debug information for some importers such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Microsoft OneNote__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (only if the debug flag was enabled at import time).
The transcript of a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Meeting transcription__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which is also shown above the note's content.

The SVG picture of a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note (__TRILIUM_PH_2__), and of each drawing canvas in a text note (see __TRILIUM_PH_3__Drawing canvases__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in __TRILIUM_PH_5__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_6__), used for previews and shared pages.
The system attachments are displayed at the end of the attachments list, in a dedicated section (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Generated by Trilium__TRILIUM_PH_1__).
Uploading attachments__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_2__ item of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_4__ opens the list of the note's attachments.
To upload files as attachments, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Upload attachments__TRILIUM_PH_1__ at the top of the list and select one or more files.

Alternatively, drag one or more files from the file explorer and drop them anywhere on the list. Pictures are compressed if __TRILIUM_PH_0__Automatic image compression__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is enabled in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Options__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Media__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
Attaching files from a text note__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: To attach files to a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note and embed them in its content, press the __TRILIUM_PH_2____TRILIUM_PH_3__Attach file__TRILIUM_PH_4__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_6__, choose __TRILIUM_PH_7__Attach and embed file__TRILIUM_PH_8__ and select one or more files (see __TRILIUM_PH_9__Embedding an attachment__TRILIUM_PH_10__ below). The same menu offers __TRILIUM_PH_11__Image__TRILIUM_PH_12__, which inserts pictures (see __TRILIUM_PH_13__Images__TRILIUM_PH_14__), and __TRILIUM_PH_15__Attach file as a link__TRILIUM_PH_16__, which links the files instead. Both file actions are also available as __TRILIUM_PH_17__Attach file as a link__TRILIUM_PH_18__ and __TRILIUM_PH_19__Attach and embed file__TRILIUM_PH_20__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_21__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_22__. On a phone, the menu also offers __TRILIUM_PH_23__Camera__TRILIUM_PH_24__ (see __TRILIUM_PH_25__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_26__).
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: When files are attached as links:
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: Each file becomes an attachment of the note, and a link to it is inserted at the cursor. Several files produce several links, separated by a space.
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: While a file uploads, its link shows the file name and a toast shows the progress.
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: Pictures appear as links rather than images, and are attached exactly as they are, without being compressed. To display a picture in the text, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Image__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the same menu instead (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Images__TRILIUM_PH_3__).
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: Dragging a file that is not a picture from the file explorer onto the text also attaches it and inserts a link to it.
units.context: Attachments > Attaching files from a text note

units.source: Acting on an attachment link__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Attachments > Acting on an attachment link

units.source: Right-clicking a link to an attachment shows the ways to open it, followed by actions on the attachment: opening it externally, downloading it, uploading a new revision, renaming or deleting it, and converting it into a note. In a text note being edited, the same entries are in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu of the popup of the link, which right-clicking the link opens. The popup also has a __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Download__TRILIUM_PH_5__ button.
units.context: Attachments > Acting on an attachment link

units.source: Links follow changes to their attachment: renaming it updates the title they show, and deleting it removes them from the text notes open for editing at that moment. Converting it into a note turns its links into links to the new note.
units.context: Attachments > Acting on an attachment link

units.source: Embedding an attachment__TRILIUM_PH_0__

An attachment can be shown in the text instead of linked, the way __TRILIUM_PH_0__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ shows a note: a picture is displayed, a PDF, a video or a document is previewed, a code or text file is shown with syntax highlighting, and a Markdown file such as a __TRILIUM_PH_2__ file is shown rendered. An embedded code file can also be edited in place (see __TRILIUM_PH_3__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in __TRILIUM_PH_5__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_6__), and an embedded Markdown file shows its source, its rendering or both, as an included Markdown note does (see __TRILIUM_PH_7__Included Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_8__ there).

To attach files and embed them straight away, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Attach file__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button and choose __TRILIUM_PH_3__Attach and embed file__TRILIUM_PH_4__. Each file gets an embed of its own, which shows the file name while the file uploads.
To embed an attachment that is already linked, right-click a link to it in a text note being edited and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Convert link to an embed__TRILIUM_PH_1__, near the end of the menu.

A drawing canvas, inserted with __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_3____TRILIUM_PH_4__Insert__TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu, is an embed of a __TRILIUM_PH_6__ attachment that can be drawn on in place. An attached Excalidraw file (__TRILIUM_PH_7__) is embedded as a drawing canvas too (see __TRILIUM_PH_8__Drawing canvases__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in __TRILIUM_PH_10__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_11__).

An embed gets the box size that suits the attachment, as a new included note does (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Box sizes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ there). To change its size, select the embed and use the box size menu in its toolbar, or the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Size__TRILIUM_PH_3__ submenu of its __TRILIUM_PH_4____TRILIUM_PH_5__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_6__ menu. A __TRILIUM_PH_7__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_8__ embed can also be resized by dragging its handles, and an __TRILIUM_PH_9__Expandable__TRILIUM_PH_10__ one in height (see __TRILIUM_PH_11__Resizing__TRILIUM_PH_12__ there). A __TRILIUM_PH_13__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_14__ embed can be placed at the left or the right of the note, with or without the text running beside it, from the __TRILIUM_PH_15__Position__TRILIUM_PH_16__ submenu of its menu (see __TRILIUM_PH_17__Positioning__TRILIUM_PH_18__ there).
An embed can have a caption, as an included note can (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Caption__TRILIUM_PH_1__ there).

To show only the attachment, turn off __TRILIUM_PH_0__Show title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the embed's __TRILIUM_PH_2____TRILIUM_PH_3__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_4__ menu, as for an included note (see __TRILIUM_PH_5__Title__TRILIUM_PH_6__ there).
To open the attachment in a new tab, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ (__TRILIUM_PH_1__Open in new tab)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the end of the embed's title.

An embed of size __TRILIUM_PH_0__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_1__ shows only the title of the attachment and its size, in a single row, whatever the attachment is: a drawing canvas or a video shows nothing of its content there. Its buttons are __TRILIUM_PH_2____TRILIUM_PH_3__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_4__ and __TRILIUM_PH_5____TRILIUM_PH_6__Download__TRILIUM_PH_7__. An audio file at __TRILIUM_PH_8__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_9__ is a row of player controls instead, without its title until __TRILIUM_PH_10__Show title__TRILIUM_PH_11__ is turned on.

To show an embed of size __TRILIUM_PH_0__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__ on the whole screen, press the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ (__TRILIUM_PH_5__Fullscreen)__TRILIUM_PH_6__ button at the end of its title. To return, press __TRILIUM_PH_7__ (__TRILIUM_PH_8__Exit fullscreen)__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in the top-right corner, or __TRILIUM_PH_10__Esc__TRILIUM_PH_11__.

To turn the embed back into a link, choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__Convert to link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the menu that right-clicking the title row of the embed or pressing its __TRILIUM_PH_2____TRILIUM_PH_3__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_4__ button opens. It is in the last group, after __TRILIUM_PH_5____TRILIUM_PH_6__Delete block__TRILIUM_PH_7__, which removes the embed from the note, and __TRILIUM_PH_8____TRILIUM_PH_9__Delete attachment...__TRILIUM_PH_10__, which deletes the attachment itself. __TRILIUM_PH_11____TRILIUM_PH_12__Convert attachment into note...__TRILIUM_PH_13__ follows it.

An embed follows its attachment like a link does. Converting the attachment into a note turns the embed into an included note. In a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, an embedded picture is displayed with its caption, a drawing canvas as a picture of the drawing, a video or audio file in the browser's player, and any other attachment, or a picture in a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_3__ embed, appears as a link to download it.
Converting notes to attachments__TRILIUM_PH_0__
__TRILIUM_PH_0__File__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes can be easily converted to attachments of the parent note.
To do so:
For a single note, press the context menu from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Convert into attachment__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
For multiple notes, select the given notes in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__, right click → Advanced → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Convert to attachment…__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Attachment previews__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Attachments share the same content preview for images, videos, PDFs, etc. as the __TRILIUM_PH_0__File__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note type. A Markdown attachment is previewed rendered, as a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_3__ note is.
